nodes.label: pnpm-workspace.yaml
nodes.rationale: Hoisted node linker with hoistingLimits workspaces gives React Native the flat node_modules its autolinking/CocoaPods/Gradle codegen assume, without one giant root pile; pnpm's default isolated symlink farm breaks RN with opaque codegen errors.

nodes.label: React/react-dom exact version override (19.2.3)
nodes.rationale: Duplicate React in one app is a runtime error and a ^ range could split web and mobile; react-native@0.86 peers ^19.2.3 so the tighter constraint wins and one version serves both apps.

nodes.label: @livekit/components-react override (2.9.19)
nodes.rationale: @elevenlabs/client pins livekit-client to exactly 2.16.1; 2.9.19 is the newest components-react whose peer range still accepts it, and it loads at module scope via @livekit/react-native hooks.ts.

nodes.label: allowBuilds postinstall approvals
nodes.rationale: pnpm 10+ blocks dependency postinstall scripts until named; unanswered packages make pnpm install exit non-zero, so unwanted ones are explicitly denied.
